segments.dn23:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā kumārakassapo kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena setabyā nāma kosalānaṃ nagaraṃ tadavasari.
segments.dn23:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ āyasmā kumārakassapo setabyāyaṃ viharati uttarena setabyaṃ siṃsapāvane [sīsapāvane (syā.)].
segments.dn23:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena pāyāsi rājañño setabyaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
segments.dn23:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena pāyāsissa rājaññassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:2.2: “itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ [sukaṭakkaṭānaṃ (sī. pī.)] kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.dn23:2.4: “samaṇo khalu bho kumārakassapo samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi setabyaṃ anuppatto setabyāyaṃ viharati uttarena setabyaṃ siṃsapāvane.
segments.dn23:2.5: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ kumārakassapaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.dn23:2.6: ‘paṇḍito byatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho [buddho (syā. ka.)] ceva arahā ca.
segments.dn23:2.7: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’”ti.
segments.dn23:2.8: Atha kho setabyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā setabyāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarenamukhā gacchanti yena siṃsapāvanaṃ [yena siṃsapāvanaṃ, tenupasaṅkamanti (sī. pī.)].
segments.dn23:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena pāyāsi rājañño uparipāsāde divāseyyaṃ upagato hoti.
segments.dn23:3.2: Addasā kho pāyāsi rājañño setabyake brāhmaṇagahapatike setabyāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūte uttarenamukhe gacchante yena siṃsapāvanaṃ [yena siṃsapāvanaṃ, tenupasaṅkamante (sī. pī.)], disvā khattaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn23:3.4: “kiṃ nu kho, bho khatte, setabyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā setabyāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarenamukhā gacchanti yena siṃsapāvanan”ti [ettha pana sabbatthapi evameva dissati, natthi pāṭhantaraṃ]?
segments.dn23:3.5: “Atthi kho, bho, samaṇo kumārakassapo, samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi setabyaṃ anuppatto setabyāyaṃ viharati uttarena setabyaṃ siṃsapāvane.
segments.dn23:3.6: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ kumārakassapaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.dn23:3.7: ‘paṇḍito byatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho ceva arahā cā’ti [arahā ca (syā. ka.)].
segments.dn23:3.8: Tamete [tamenaṃ te (sī. ka.), tamenaṃ (pī.)] bhavantaṃ kumārakassapaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamantī”ti.
segments.dn23:3.9: “Tena hi, bho khatte, yena setabyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā setabyake brāhmaṇagahapatike evaṃ vadehi –
segments.dn23:3.10: ‘pāyāsi, bho, rājañño evamāha – āgamentu kira bhavanto, pāyāsipi rājañño samaṇaṃ kumārakassapaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’ti.
segments.dn23:3.12: Purā samaṇo kumārakassapo setabyake brāhmaṇagahapatike bāle abyatte saññāpeti –
segments.dn23:3.13: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’ti.
segments.dn23:3.14: Natthi hi, bho khatte, paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.dn23:3.15: “Evaṃ bho”ti kho so khattā pāyāsissa rājaññassa paṭissutvā yena setabyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā setabyake brāhmaṇagahapatike etadavoca –
segments.dn23:3.16: “pāyāsi, bho, rājañño evamāha, āgamentu kira bhavanto, pāyāsipi rājañño samaṇaṃ kumārakassapaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti.
segments.dn23:4.1: Atha kho pāyāsi rājañño setabyakehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi parivuto yena siṃsapāvanaṃ yenāyasmā kumārakassapo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā kumārakassapena saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn23:4.2: Setabyakāpi kho brāhmaṇagahapatikā appekacce āyasmantaṃ kumārakassapaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu;
segments.dn23:4.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
segments.dn23:4.5: Appekacce yenāyasmā kumārakassapo tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
segments.dn23:5.1: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pāyāsi rājañño āyasmantaṃ kumārakassapaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:5.3: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:5.4: “Nāhaṃ, rājañña, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā.
segments.dn23:5.6: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’ti?
segments.dn23:5.8: “Tena hi, rājañña, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.dn23:5.9: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājañña, ime candimasūriyā imasmiṃ vā loke parasmiṃ vā, devā vā te manussā vā”ti?
segments.dn23:5.11: “Ime, bho kassapa, candimasūriyā parasmiṃ loke, na imasmiṃ; devā te na manussā”ti.
segments.dn23:5.12: “Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu – itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.dn23:6.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:6.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:6.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo, yena te pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:6.4: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti?
segments.dn23:6.5: “Atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:6.6: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:6.8: “Idha me, bho kassapa, mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavācā pharusavācā samphappalāpī abhijjhālū byāpannacittā micchādiṭṭhī.
segments.dn23:6.9: Te aparena samayena ābādhikā honti dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā.
segments.dn23:6.11: ‘na dānime imamhā ābādhā vuṭṭhahissantī’ti tyāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi –
segments.dn23:6.12: ‘santi kho, bho, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino – ye te pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavācā pharusavācā samphappalāpī abhijjhālū byāpannacittā micchādiṭṭhī, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī’ti.
segments.dn23:6.14: Bhavanto kho pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavācā pharusavācā samphappalāpī abhijjhālū byāpannacittā micchādiṭṭhī.
segments.dn23:6.15: Sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, bhavanto kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissanti.
segments.dn23:6.16: Sace, bho, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyātha, yena me āgantvā āroceyyātha –
segments.dn23:6.17: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’ti.
segments.dn23:6.18: Bhavanto kho pana me saddhāyikā paccayikā, yaṃ bhavantehi diṭṭhaṃ, yathā sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ evametaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.dn23:6.19: Te me ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā neva āgantvā ārocenti, na pana dūtaṃ pahiṇanti.
segments.dn23:6.20: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:6.21: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:7.1: “Tena hi, rājañña, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.dn23:7.2: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājañña, idha te purisā coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā dasseyyuṃ –
segments.dn23:7.5: imassa yaṃ icchasi, taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī’ti.
segments.dn23:7.7: ‘tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā [kāretvā (syā. ka.)] kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ [rathiyāya rathiyaṃ (bahūsū)] siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa āghātane sīsaṃ chindathā’ti.
segments.dn23:7.8: Te ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa āghātane nisīdāpeyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:7.9: Labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu –
segments.dn23:7.10: ‘āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāvāhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī’ti, udāhu vippalapantasseva coraghātā sīsaṃ chindeyyun”ti?
segments.dn23:7.11: “Na hi so, bho kassapa, coro labheyya coraghātesu –
segments.dn23:7.12: ‘āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāvāhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī’ti.
segments.dn23:7.13: Atha kho naṃ vippalapantasseva coraghātā sīsaṃ chindeyyun”ti.
segments.dn23:7.14: “So hi nāma, rājañña, coro manusso manussabhūtesu coraghātesu na labhissati –
segments.dn23:7.15: ‘āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāvāhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī’ti.
segments.dn23:7.16: Kiṃ pana te mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavācā pharusavācā samphappalāpī abhijjhālū byāpannacittā micchādiṭṭhī, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā labhissanti nirayapālesu –
segments.dn23:7.17: ‘āgamentu tāva bhavanto nirayapālā, yāva mayaṃ pāyāsissa rājaññassa gantvā ārocema –
segments.dn23:7.18: “itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti?
segments.dn23:7.19: Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu –
segments.dn23:7.20: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:8.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:8.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.dn23:8.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo yena te pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:8.4: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti?
segments.dn23:8.5: “Atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:8.6: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:8.8: “Idha me, bho kassapa, mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā pisuṇāya vācāya paṭiviratā pharusāya vācāya paṭiviratā samphappalāpā paṭiviratā anabhijjhālū abyāpannacittā sammādiṭṭhī.
segments.dn23:8.9: Te aparena samayena ābādhikā honti dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā.
segments.dn23:8.11: ‘na dānime imamhā ābādhā vuṭṭhahissantī’ti tyāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi –
segments.dn23:8.12: ‘santi kho, bho, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino – ye te pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā pisuṇāya vācāya paṭiviratā pharusāya vācāya paṭiviratā samphappalāpā paṭiviratā anabhijjhālū abyāpannacittā sammādiṭṭhī te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
segments.dn23:8.14: Bhavanto kho pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā pisuṇāya vācāya paṭiviratā pharusāya vācāya paṭiviratā samphappalāpā paṭiviratā anabhijjhālū abyāpannacittā sammādiṭṭhī.
segments.dn23:8.15: Sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, bhavanto kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissanti.
segments.dn23:8.16: Sace, bho, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyātha, yena me āgantvā āroceyyātha –
segments.dn23:8.17: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’ti.
segments.dn23:8.18: Bhavanto kho pana me saddhāyikā paccayikā, yaṃ bhavantehi diṭṭhaṃ, yathā sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ evametaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.dn23:8.19: Te me ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā neva āgantvā ārocenti, na pana dūtaṃ pahiṇanti.
segments.dn23:8.20: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:8.21: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:9.2: Upamāya midhekacce [upamāyapidhekacce (sī. syā.), upamāyapiidhekacce (pī.)] viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:9.3: Seyyathāpi, rājañña, puriso gūthakūpe sasīsakaṃ [sasīsako (syā.)] nimuggo assa.
segments.dn23:9.5: ‘tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ tamhā gūthakūpā uddharathā’ti.
segments.dn23:9.6: Te ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ tamhā gūthakūpā uddhareyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:9.8: ‘tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa kāyā veḷupesikāhi gūthaṃ sunimmajjitaṃ nimmajjathā’ti.
segments.dn23:9.9: Te ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā tassa purisassa kāyā veḷupesikāhi gūthaṃ sunimmajjitaṃ nimmajjeyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:9.11: ‘tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa kāyaṃ paṇḍumattikāya tikkhattuṃ subbaṭṭitaṃ ubbaṭṭethā’ti [suppaṭṭitaṃ uppaṭṭethāti (ka.)].
segments.dn23:9.12: Te tassa purisassa kāyaṃ paṇḍumattikāya tikkhattuṃ subbaṭṭitaṃ ubbaṭṭeyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:9.14: ‘tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ telena abbhañjitvā sukhumena cuṇṇena tikkhattuṃ suppadhotaṃ karothā’ti.
segments.dn23:9.15: Te taṃ purisaṃ telena abbhañjitvā sukhumena cuṇṇena tikkhattuṃ suppadhotaṃ kareyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:9.17: ‘tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa kesamassuṃ kappethā’ti.
segments.dn23:9.20: ‘tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa mahagghañca mālaṃ mahagghañca vilepanaṃ mahagghāni ca vatthāni upaharathā’ti.
segments.dn23:9.21: Te tassa purisassa mahagghañca mālaṃ mahagghañca vilepanaṃ mahagghāni ca vatthāni upahareyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:9.23: ‘tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ pāsādaṃ āropetvā pañcakāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpethā’ti.
segments.dn23:9.24: Te taṃ purisaṃ pāsādaṃ āropetvā pañcakāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:9.25: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājañña, api nu tassa purisassa sunhātassa suvilittassa sukappitakesamassussa āmukkamālābharaṇassa odātavatthavasanassa uparipāsādavaragatassa pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitassa samaṅgībhūtassa paricārayamānassa punadeva tasmiṃ gūthakūpe nimujjitukāmatā [nimujjitukāmyatā (syā. ka.)] assā”ti?
segments.dn23:9.29: “Asuci, bho kassapa, gūthakūpo asuci ceva asucisaṅkhāto ca duggandho ca duggandhasaṅkhāto ca jeguccho ca jegucchasaṅkhāto ca paṭikūlo ca paṭikūlasaṅkhāto cā”ti.
segments.dn23:9.30: “Evameva kho, rājañña, manussā devānaṃ asucī ceva asucisaṅkhātā ca, duggandhā ca duggandhasaṅkhātā ca, jegucchā ca jegucchasaṅkhātā ca, paṭikūlā ca paṭikūlasaṅkhātā ca.
segments.dn23:9.31: Yojanasataṃ kho, rājañña, manussagandho deve ubbādhati.
segments.dn23:9.32: Kiṃ pana te mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā pisuṇāya vācāya paṭiviratā pharusāya vācāya paṭiviratā samphappalāpā paṭiviratā anabhijjhālū abyāpannacittā sammādiṭṭhī, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā te āgantvā ārocessanti –
segments.dn23:9.33: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’ti?
segments.dn23:9.34: Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu –
segments.dn23:9.35: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:10.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:10.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:10.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo … pe …“atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo … pe …`` yathā kathaṃ viya, rājaññāti?
segments.dn23:10.6: “Idha me, bho kassapa, mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā, te aparena samayena ābādhikā honti dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā.
segments.dn23:10.9: ‘na dānime imamhā ābādhā vuṭṭhahissantī’ti tyāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi –
segments.dn23:10.10: ‘santi kho, bho, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino – ye te pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyatanti.
segments.dn23:10.12: Bhavanto kho pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā.
segments.dn23:10.13: Sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, bhavanto kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissanti, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ.
segments.dn23:10.14: Sace, bho, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyātha devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ, yena me āgantvā āroceyyātha –` itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipākoti.
segments.dn23:10.16: Bhavanto kho pana me saddhāyikā paccayikā, yaṃ bhavantehi diṭṭhaṃ, yathā sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ evametaṃ bhavissatīti.
segments.dn23:10.17: Te me ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā neva āgantvā ārocenti, na pana dūtaṃ pahiṇanti.
segments.dn23:10.18: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:10.19: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:11.1: “Tena hi, rājañña, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi; yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.dn23:11.2: Yaṃ kho pana, rājañña, mānussakaṃ vassasataṃ, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ eso eko rattindivo [rattidivo (ka.)], tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso, tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo, tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
segments.dn23:11.3: Ye te mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ.
segments.dn23:11.5: ‘yāva mayaṃ dve vā tīṇi vā rattindivā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricārema, atha mayaṃ pāyāsissa rājaññassa gantvā āroceyyāma –
segments.dn23:11.6: “itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.dn23:11.8: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti?
segments.dn23:11.10: Api hi mayaṃ, bho kassapa, ciraṃ kālaṅkatāpi bhaveyyāma.
segments.dn23:11.12: ‘atthi devā tāvatiṃsā’ti vā ‘evaṃdīghāyukā devā tāvatiṃsā’ti vā.
segments.dn23:11.14: ‘atthi devā tāvatiṃsā’ti vā ‘evaṃdīghāyukā devā tāvatiṃsā’ti vā”ti.
segments.dn23:11.16: “Seyyathāpi, rājañña, jaccandho puriso na passeyya kaṇha – sukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni [mañjeṭṭhakāni (syā.)] rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni, na passeyya mañjiṭṭhakāni rūpāni, na passeyya samavisamaṃ, na passeyya tārakāni rūpāni, na passeyya candimasūriye.
segments.dn23:11.18: ‘natthi kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, natthi kaṇhasukkānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.19: Natthi nīlakāni rūpāni, natthi nīlakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.20: Natthi pītakāni rūpāni, natthi pītakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.21: Natthi lohitakāni rūpāni, natthi lohitakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.22: Natthi mañjiṭṭhakāni rūpāni, natthi mañjiṭṭhakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.24: Natthi tārakāni rūpāni, natthi tārakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.26: Ahametaṃ na jānāmi, ahametaṃ na passāmi, tasmā taṃ natthī’ti.
segments.dn23:11.27: Sammā nu kho so, rājañña, vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.dn23:11.29: Atthi kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, atthi kaṇhasukkānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.30: Atthi nīlakāni rūpāni, atthi nīlakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī … pe … atthi samavisamaṃ, atthi samavisamassa dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.32: Atthi tārakāni rūpāni, atthi tārakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī.
segments.dn23:11.34: ‘Ahametaṃ na jānāmi, ahametaṃ na passāmi, tasmā taṃ natthī’ti.
segments.dn23:11.35: Na hi so, bho kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyyā”ti.
segments.dn23:11.36: “Evameva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, jaccandhūpamo maññe paṭibhāsi yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadesi”.
segments.dn23:11.38: ‘atthi devā tāvatiṃsā”ti vā,‘evaṃdīghāyukā devā tāvatiṃsā’ti vā?
segments.dn23:11.40: ‘atthi devā tāvatiṃsā’ti vā ‘evaṃdīghāyukā devā tāvatiṃsā’ti vā”ti.
segments.dn23:11.41: “Na kho, rājañña, evaṃ paro loko daṭṭhabbo, yathā tvaṃ maññasi iminā maṃsacakkhunā.
segments.dn23:11.42: Ye kho te rājañña samaṇabrāhmaṇā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, te tattha appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharantā dibbacakkhuṃ visodhenti.
segments.dn23:11.43: Te dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena imaṃ ceva lokaṃ passanti parañca satte ca opapātike.
segments.dn23:11.44: Evañca kho, rājañña, paro loko daṭṭhabbo;
segments.dn23:11.45: natveva yathā tvaṃ maññasi iminā maṃsacakkhunā.
segments.dn23:11.46: Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu –
segments.dn23:11.47: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:12.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:12.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.dn23:12.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo … pe … atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo … pe … yathā kathaṃ viya, rājaññā”ti?
segments.dn23:12.6: “Idhāhaṃ, bho kassapa, passāmi samaṇabrāhmaṇe sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme jīvitukāme amaritukāme sukhakāme dukkhapaṭikūle.
segments.dn23:12.7: Tassa mayhaṃ, bho kassapa, evaṃ hoti – sace kho ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā evaṃ jāneyyuṃ –
segments.dn23:12.10: Idānime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā visaṃ vā khādeyyuṃ, satthaṃ vā āhareyyuṃ, ubbandhitvā vā kālaṅkareyyuṃ, papāte vā papateyyuṃ.
segments.dn23:12.11: Yasmā ca kho ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā na evaṃ jānanti –
segments.dn23:12.12: ‘ito no matānaṃ seyyo bhavissatī’ti, tasmā ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā jīvitukāmā amaritukāmā sukhakāmā dukkhapaṭikūlā attānaṃ na mārenti [() natthi (syā. pī.)].
segments.dn23:12.13: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:12.14: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:13.2: Upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:13.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa dve pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ.
segments.dn23:13.4: Ekissā putto ahosi dasavassuddesiko vā dvādasavassuddesiko vā, ekā gabbhinī upavijaññā.
segments.dn23:13.6: Atha kho so māṇavako mātusapattiṃ [mātusapatiṃ (syā.)] etadavoca –
segments.dn23:13.7: ‘yamidaṃ, bhoti, dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ mayhaṃ;
segments.dn23:13.9: Pitu me [pitu me santako (syā.)] bhoti, dāyajjaṃ niyyādehī’ti [nīyyātehīti (sī. pī.)].
segments.dn23:13.10: Evaṃ vutte sā brāhmaṇī taṃ māṇavakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:13.12: Sace kumārako bhavissati, tassapi ekadeso bhavissati;
segments.dn23:13.13: sace kumārikā bhavissati, sāpi te opabhoggā [upabhoggā (syā.)] bhavissatī’ti.
segments.dn23:13.14: Dutiyampi kho so māṇavako mātusapattiṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:13.15: ‘yamidaṃ, bhoti, dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ mayhaṃ;
segments.dn23:13.18: Dutiyampi kho sā brāhmaṇī taṃ māṇavakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:13.20: Sace kumārako bhavissati, tassapi ekadeso bhavissati;
segments.dn23:13.21: sace kumārikā bhavissati sāpi te opabhoggā [upabhoggā (syā.)] bhavissatī’ti.
segments.dn23:13.22: Tatiyampi kho so māṇavako mātusapattiṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:13.23: ‘yamidaṃ, bhoti, dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ mayhaṃ;
segments.dn23:13.26: “Atha kho sā brāhmaṇī satthaṃ gahetvā ovarakaṃ pavisitvā udaraṃ opādesi [uppātesi (syā.)]–
segments.dn23:13.27: ‘yāva vijāyāmi yadi vā kumārako yadi vā kumārikā’ti.
segments.dn23:13.28: Sā attānaṃ ceva jīvitañca gabbhañca sāpateyyañca vināsesi.
segments.dn23:13.29: Yathā taṃ bālā abyattā anayabyasanaṃ āpannā ayoniso dāyajjaṃ gavesantī, evameva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, bālo abyatto anayabyasanaṃ āpajjissasi ayoniso paralokaṃ gavesanto;
segments.dn23:13.30: seyyathāpi sā brāhmaṇī bālā abyattā anayabyasanaṃ āpannā ayoniso dāyajjaṃ gavesantī.
segments.dn23:13.31: Na kho, rājañña, samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā apakkaṃ paripācenti;
segments.dn23:13.33: Paṇḍitānaṃ attho hi, rājañña, samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sīlavantānaṃ kalyāṇadhammānaṃ jīvitena.
segments.dn23:13.34: Yathā yathā kho, rājañña, samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti, tathā tathā bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti, bahujanahitāya ca paṭipajjanti bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
segments.dn23:13.35: Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu –
segments.dn23:13.36: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:14.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:14.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:14.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo … pe … atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo … pe … yathā kathaṃ viya, rājaññā”ti?
segments.dn23:14.6: “Idha me, bho kassapa, purisā coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā dassenti –
segments.dn23:14.8: imassa yaṃ icchasi, taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī’ti.
segments.dn23:14.10: ‘tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ jīvantaṃyeva kumbhiyā pakkhipitvā mukhaṃ pidahitvā allena cammena onandhitvā allāya mattikāya bahalāvalepanaṃ [bahalavilepanaṃ (syā. ka.)] karitvā uddhanaṃ āropetvā aggiṃ dethā’ti.
segments.dn23:14.11: Te me ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ jīvantaṃyeva kumbhiyā pakkhipitvā mukhaṃ pidahitvā allena cammena onandhitvā allāya mattikāya bahalāvalepanaṃ karitvā uddhanaṃ āropetvā aggiṃ denti.
segments.dn23:14.12: Yadā mayaṃ jānāma ‘kālaṅkato so puriso’ti, atha naṃ kumbhiṃ oropetvā ubbhinditvā mukhaṃ vivaritvā saṇikaṃ nillokema [vilokema (syā.)]–
segments.dn23:14.15: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:14.16: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:15.1: “Tena hi, rājañña, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.dn23:15.2: Abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan”ti?
segments.dn23:15.3: “Abhijānāmahaṃ, bho kassapa, divāseyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan”ti.
segments.dn23:15.4: “Rakkhanti taṃ tamhi samaye khujjāpi vāmanakāpi velāsikāpi [celāvikāpi (syā.), keḷāyikāpi (sī.)] komārikāpī”ti?
segments.dn23:15.5: “Evaṃ, bho kassapa, rakkhanti maṃ tamhi samaye khujjāpi vāmanakāpi velāsikāpi [celāvikāpi (syā.), keḷāyikāpi (sī.)] komārikāpī”ti.
segments.dn23:15.6: “Api nu tā tuyhaṃ jīvaṃ passanti pavisantaṃ vā nikkhamantaṃ vā”ti?
segments.dn23:15.8: “Tā hi nāma, rājañña, tuyhaṃ jīvantassa jīvantiyo jīvaṃ na passissanti pavisantaṃ vā nikkhamantaṃ vā.
segments.dn23:15.9: Kiṃ pana tvaṃ kālaṅkatassa jīvaṃ passissasi pavisantaṃ vā nikkhamantaṃ vā.
segments.dn23:15.10: Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu –
segments.dn23:15.11: “itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:16.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:16.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:16.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo … pe …“atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo … pe … yathā kathaṃ viya rājaññā”ti?
segments.dn23:16.6: “Idha me, bho kassapa, purisā coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā dassenti –
segments.dn23:16.8: imassa yaṃ icchasi, taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī’ti.
segments.dn23:16.10: ‘tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ jīvantaṃyeva tulāya tuletvā jiyāya anassāsakaṃ māretvā punadeva tulāya tulethā’ti.
segments.dn23:16.11: Te me ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ jīvantaṃyeva tulāya tuletvā jiyāya anassāsakaṃ māretvā punadeva tulāya tulenti.
segments.dn23:16.12: Yadā so jīvati, tadā lahutaro ca hoti mudutaro ca kammaññataro ca.
segments.dn23:16.13: Yadā pana so kālaṅkato hoti tadā garutaro ca hoti patthinnataro ca akammaññataro ca.
segments.dn23:16.14: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:16.15: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:17.2: Upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:17.3: Seyyathāpi, rājañña, puriso divasaṃ santattaṃ ayoguḷaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ tulāya tuleyya.
segments.dn23:17.4: Tamenaṃ aparena samayena sītaṃ nibbutaṃ tulāya tuleyya.
segments.dn23:17.5: Kadā nu kho so ayoguḷo lahutaro vā hoti mudutaro vā kammaññataro vā, yadā vā āditto sampajjalito sajotibhūto, yadā vā sīto nibbuto”ti?
segments.dn23:17.6: “Yadā so, bho kassapa, ayoguḷo tejosahagato ca hoti vāyosahagato ca āditto sampajjalito sajotibhūto, tadā lahutaro ca hoti mudutaro ca kammaññataro ca.
segments.dn23:17.7: Yadā pana so ayoguḷo neva tejosahagato hoti na vāyosahagato sīto nibbuto, tadā garutaro ca hoti patthinnataro ca akammaññataro cā”ti.
segments.dn23:17.8: “Evameva kho, rājañña, yadāyaṃ kāyo āyusahagato ca hoti usmāsahagato ca viññāṇasahagato ca, tadā lahutaro ca hoti mudutaro ca kammaññataro ca.
segments.dn23:17.9: Yadā panāyaṃ kāyo neva āyusahagato hoti na usmāsahagato na viññāṇasahagato tadā garutaro ca hoti patthinnataro ca akammaññataro ca.
segments.dn23:17.10: Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu –
segments.dn23:17.11: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:18.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:18.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:18.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo … pe … atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo … pe … yathā kathaṃ viya rājaññā”ti?
segments.dn23:18.6: “Idha me, bho kassapa, purisā coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā dassenti –
segments.dn23:18.8: imassa yaṃ icchasi, taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī’ti.
segments.dn23:18.10: ‘tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ anupahacca chaviñca cammañca maṃsañca nhāruñca aṭṭhiñca aṭṭhimiñjañca jīvitā voropetha, appeva nāmassa jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passeyyāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:18.11: Te me ‘sādhū’ti paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ anupahacca chaviñca … pe … jīvitā voropenti.
segments.dn23:18.12: Yadā so āmato hoti, tyāhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi –
segments.dn23:18.13: ‘tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ uttānaṃ nipātetha, appeva nāmassa jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passeyyāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:18.17: ‘tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ avakujjaṃ nipātetha … passena nipātetha … dutiyena passena nipātetha … uddhaṃ ṭhapetha … omuddhakaṃ ṭhapetha … pāṇinā ākoṭetha … leḍḍunā ākoṭetha … daṇḍena ākoṭetha … satthena ākoṭetha … odhunātha sandhunātha niddhunātha, appeva nāmassa jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passeyyāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:18.27: Te taṃ purisaṃ odhunanti sandhunanti niddhunanti.
segments.dn23:18.29: Tassa tadeva cakkhu hoti te rūpā, tañcāyatanaṃ nappaṭisaṃvedeti.
segments.dn23:18.30: Tadeva sotaṃ hoti te saddā, tañcāyatanaṃ nappaṭisaṃvedeti.
segments.dn23:18.31: Tadeva ghānaṃ hoti te gandhā, tañcāyatanaṃ nappaṭisaṃvedeti.
segments.dn23:18.32: Sāva jivhā hoti te rasā, tañcāyatanaṃ nappaṭisaṃvedeti.
segments.dn23:18.33: Sveva kāyo hoti te phoṭṭhabbā, tañcāyatanaṃ nappaṭisaṃvedeti.
segments.dn23:18.34: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:18.35: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:19.2: Upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:19.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, aññataro saṅkhadhamo saṅkhaṃ ādāya paccantimaṃ janapadaṃ agamāsi.
segments.dn23:19.4: So yena aññataro gāmo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā majjhe gāmassa ṭhito tikkhattuṃ saṅkhaṃ upalāpetvā saṅkhaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn23:19.5: Atha kho, rājañña, tesaṃ paccantajanapadānaṃ [paccantajānaṃ (sī.)] manussānaṃ etadahosi –
segments.dn23:19.6: ‘ambho kassa nu kho [etadahosi “kissa dukho (pī.)] eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo’ti.
segments.dn23:19.8: ‘ambho, kassa nu kho eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo’ti.
segments.dn23:19.9: ‘Eso kho, bho, saṅkho nāma yasseso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo’ti.
segments.dn23:19.13: Te taṃ saṅkhaṃ avakujjaṃ nipātesuṃ, passena nipātesuṃ, dutiyena passena nipātesuṃ, uddhaṃ ṭhapesuṃ, omuddhakaṃ ṭhapesuṃ, pāṇinā ākoṭesuṃ, leḍḍunā ākoṭesuṃ, daṇḍena ākoṭesuṃ, satthena ākoṭesuṃ, odhuniṃsu sandhuniṃsu niddhuniṃsu –
segments.dn23:19.17: ‘yāva bālā ime paccantajanapadāmanussā, kathañhi nāma ayoniso saṅkhasaddaṃ gavesissantī’ti.
segments.dn23:19.18: Tesaṃ pekkhamānānaṃ saṅkhaṃ gahetvā tikkhattuṃ saṅkhaṃ upalāpetvā saṅkhaṃ ādāya pakkāmi.
segments.dn23:19.19: Atha kho, rājañña, tesaṃ paccantajanapadānaṃ manussānaṃ etadahosi –
segments.dn23:19.20: ‘yadā kira, bho, ayaṃ saṅkho nāma purisasahagato ca hoti vāyāmasahagato [vāyosahagato (syā.)] ca vāyusahagato ca, tadāyaṃ saṅkho saddaṃ karoti, yadā panāyaṃ saṅkho neva purisasahagato hoti na vāyāmasahagato na vāyusahagato, nāyaṃ saṅkho saddaṃ karotī’ti.
segments.dn23:19.21: Evameva kho, rājañña, yadāyaṃ kāyo āyusahagato ca hoti usmāsahagato ca viññāṇasahagato ca, tadā abhikkamatipi paṭikkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyampi kappeti, cakkhunāpi rūpaṃ passati, sotenapi saddaṃ suṇāti, ghānenapi gandhaṃ ghāyati, jivhāyapi rasaṃ sāyati, kāyenapi phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusati, manasāpi dhammaṃ vijānāti.
segments.dn23:19.22: Yadā panāyaṃ kāyo neva āyusahagato hoti, na usmāsahagato, na viññāṇasahagato, tadā neva abhikkamati na paṭikkamati na tiṭṭhati na nisīdati na seyyaṃ kappeti, cakkhunāpi rūpaṃ na passati, sotenapi saddaṃ na suṇāti, ghānenapi gandhaṃ na ghāyati, jivhāyapi rasaṃ na sāyati, kāyenapi phoṭṭhabbaṃ na phusati, manasāpi dhammaṃ na vijānāti.
segments.dn23:19.23: Imināpi kho te, rājañña, pariyāyena evaṃ hotu –
segments.dn23:19.24: ‘itipi atthi paro loko, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’ti [vipākoti, paṭhamabhāṇavāraṃ (syā.)].
segments.dn23:20.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho evaṃ me ettha hoti –
segments.dn23:20.2: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:20.3: “Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo … pe … atthi, bho kassapa, pariyāyo … pe … yathā kathaṃ viya rājaññā”ti?
segments.dn23:20.6: “Idha me, bho kassapa, purisā coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā dassenti –
segments.dn23:20.7: ‘ayaṃ te, bhante, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi, taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī’ti.
segments.dn23:20.10: ‘tena hi, bho, imassa purisassa chaviṃ chindatha, appeva nāmassa jīvaṃ passeyyāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:20.14: ‘tena hi, bho, imassa purisassa cammaṃ chindatha, maṃsaṃ chindatha, nhāruṃ chindatha, aṭṭhiṃ chindatha, aṭṭhimiñjaṃ chindatha, appeva nāmassa jīvaṃ passeyyāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:20.15: Te tassa purisassa aṭṭhimiñjaṃ chindanti, nevassa mayaṃ jīvaṃ passeyyāma.
segments.dn23:20.16: Ayampi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn23:20.17: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti.
segments.dn23:21.2: Upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:21.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, aññataro aggiko jaṭilo araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭiyā sammati [vasati (sī. pī.)].
segments.dn23:21.4: Atha kho, rājañña, aññataro janapade sattho [sattho janapadapadesā (sī.), janapado satthavāso (syā.), janapadapadeso (pī.)] vuṭṭhāsi.
segments.dn23:21.5: Atha kho so sattho [satthavāso (syā.)] tassa aggikassa jaṭilassa assamassa sāmantā ekarattiṃ vasitvā pakkāmi.
segments.dn23:21.6: Atha kho, rājañña, tassa aggikassa jaṭilassa etadahosi –
segments.dn23:21.7: ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena so satthavāso tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ, appeva nāmettha kiñci upakaraṇaṃ adhigaccheyyan’ti.
segments.dn23:21.8: Atha kho so aggiko jaṭilo kālasseva vuṭṭhāya yena so satthavāso tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā addasa tasmiṃ satthavāse daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ.
segments.dn23:21.10: ‘na kho me taṃ patirūpaṃ yaṃ me pekkhamānassa manussabhūto kālaṅkareyya;
segments.dn23:21.11: yaṃnūnāhaṃ imaṃ dārakaṃ assamaṃ netvā āpādeyyaṃ poseyyaṃ vaḍḍheyyan’ti.
segments.dn23:21.12: Atha kho so aggiko jaṭilo taṃ dārakaṃ assamaṃ netvā āpādesi posesi vaḍḍhesi.
segments.dn23:21.13: Yadā so dārako dasavassuddesiko vā hoti [ahosi (?)] dvādasavassuddesiko vā, atha kho tassa aggikassa jaṭilassa janapade kañcideva karaṇīyaṃ uppajji.
segments.dn23:21.14: Atha kho so aggiko jaṭilo taṃ dārakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:21.18: Sace ca te aggi nibbāyeyya, ayaṃ vāsī imāni kaṭṭhāni idaṃ araṇisahitaṃ, aggiṃ nibbattetvā aggiṃ paricareyyāsī’ti.
segments.dn23:21.19: Atha kho so aggiko jaṭilo taṃ dārakaṃ evaṃ anusāsitvā janapadaṃ agamāsi.
segments.dn23:21.25: Sace ca te aggi nibbāyeyya, ayaṃ vāsī imāni kaṭṭhāni idaṃ araṇisahitaṃ, aggiṃ nibbattetvā aggiṃ paricareyyāsī”ti.
segments.dn23:21.27: Atha kho so dārako araṇisahitaṃ vāsiyā tacchi –
segments.dn23:21.30: Araṇisahitaṃ dvidhā phālesi, tidhā phālesi, catudhā phālesi, pañcadhā phālesi, dasadhā phālesi, satadhā [vīsatidhā (syā.)] phālesi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ akāsi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā udukkhale koṭṭesi, udukkhale koṭṭetvā mahāvāte opuni [ophuni (syā. ka.)]–
segments.dn23:21.33: “Atha kho so aggiko jaṭilo janapade taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena sako assamo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ dārakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:21.37: “pitā kho maṃ evaṃ avaca aggiṃ, tāta, paricareyyāsi.
segments.dn23:21.38: Mā ca te, tāta, aggi nibbāyi.
segments.dn23:21.39: Sace ca te aggi nibbāyeyya, ayaṃ vāsī imāni kaṭṭhāni idaṃ araṇisahitaṃ, aggiṃ nibbattetvā aggiṃ paricareyyāsīti.
segments.dn23:21.41: Atha khvāhaṃ, tāta, araṇisahitaṃ vāsiyā tacchiṃ –
segments.dn23:21.44: Araṇisahitaṃ dvidhā phālesiṃ, tidhā phālesiṃ, catudhā phālesiṃ, pañcadhā phālesiṃ, dasadhā phālesiṃ, satadhā phālesiṃ, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ akāsiṃ, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā udukkhale koṭṭesiṃ, udukkhale koṭṭetvā mahāvāte opuniṃ –
segments.dn23:21.47: Atha kho tassa aggikassa jaṭilassa etadahosi –
segments.dn23:21.48: ‘yāva bālo ayaṃ dārako abyatto, kathañhi nāma ayoniso aggiṃ gavesissatī’ti.
segments.dn23:21.49: Tassa pekkhamānassa araṇisahitaṃ gahetvā aggiṃ nibbattetvā taṃ dārakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:21.51: Na tveva yathā tvaṃ bālo abyatto ayoniso aggiṃ gavesī’ti.
segments.dn23:21.52: Evameva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, bālo abyatto ayoniso paralokaṃ gavesissasi.
segments.dn23:21.53: Paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ, paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ, mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti.
segments.dn23:22.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho nevāhaṃ sakkomi idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjituṃ.
segments.dn23:22.2: Rājāpi maṃ pasenadi kosalo jānāti tirorājānopi –
segments.dn23:22.4: “itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.dn23:22.5: Sacāhaṃ, bho kassapa, idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjissāmi, bhavissanti me vattāro –
segments.dn23:22.7: Kopenapi naṃ harissāmi, makkhenapi naṃ harissāmi, palāsenapi naṃ harissāmī”ti.
segments.dn23:23.2: Upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:23.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, mahāsakaṭasattho sakaṭasahassaṃ puratthimā janapadā pacchimaṃ janapadaṃ agamāsi.
segments.dn23:23.4: So yena yena gacchi, khippaṃyeva pariyādiyati tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ haritakapaṇṇaṃ.
segments.dn23:23.5: Tasmiṃ kho pana satthe dve satthavāhā ahesuṃ eko pañcannaṃ sakaṭasatānaṃ, eko pañcannaṃ sakaṭasatānaṃ.
segments.dn23:23.8: te mayaṃ yena yena gacchāma, khippameva pariyādiyati tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ haritakapaṇṇaṃ.
segments.dn23:23.9: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ imaṃ satthaṃ dvidhā vibhajeyyāma – ekato pañca sakaṭasatāni ekato pañca sakaṭasatānī’ti.
segments.dn23:23.11: Te taṃ satthaṃ dvidhā vibhajiṃsu [vibhajesuṃ (ka.)] ekato pañca sakaṭasatāni, ekato pañca sakaṭasatāni.
segments.dn23:23.12: Eko satthavāho bahuṃ tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca udakañca āropetvā satthaṃ payāpesi [pāyāpesi (sī. pī.)].
segments.dn23:23.13: Dvīhatīhapayāto kho pana so sattho addasa purisaṃ kāḷaṃ lohitakkhaṃ [lohitakkhiṃ (syā.)] sannaddhakalāpaṃ [āsannaddhakalāpaṃ (syā.)] kumudamāliṃ allavatthaṃ allakesaṃ kaddamamakkhitehi cakkehi bhadrena rathena paṭipathaṃ āgacchantaṃ’, disvā etadavoca –
segments.dn23:23.19: ‘Evaṃ, bho, purato kantāre mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho, āsittodakāni vaṭumāni, bahu tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca udakañca.
segments.dn23:23.20: Chaḍḍetha, bho, purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, lahubhārehi sakaṭehi sīghaṃ sīghaṃ gacchatha, mā yoggāni kilamitthā’ti.
segments.dn23:23.23: “purato kantāre mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho, āsittodakāni vaṭumāni, bahu tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca udakañca.
segments.dn23:23.24: Chaḍḍetha, bho, purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, lahubhārehi sakaṭehi sīghaṃ sīghaṃ gacchatha, mā yoggāni kilamitthā”ti.
segments.dn23:23.25: Chaḍḍetha, bho, purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, lahubhārehi sakaṭehi satthaṃ payāpethā’ti.
segments.dn23:23.26: ‘Evaṃ, bho’ti kho te satthikā tassa satthavāhassa paṭissutvā chaḍḍetvā purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni lahubhārehi sakaṭehi satthaṃ payāpesuṃ.
segments.dn23:23.27: Te paṭhamepi satthavāse na addasaṃsu tiṇaṃ vā kaṭṭhaṃ vā udakaṃ vā.
segments.dn23:23.28: Dutiyepi satthavāse … tatiyepi satthavāse … catutthepi satthavāse … pañcamepi satthavāse … chaṭṭhepi satthavāse … sattamepi satthavāse na addasaṃsu tiṇaṃ vā kaṭṭhaṃ vā udakaṃ vā.
segments.dn23:23.35: Ye ca tasmiṃ satthe ahesuṃ manussā vā pasū vā, sabbe so yakkho amanusso bhakkhesi.
segments.dn23:23.38: ‘bahunikkhanto kho, bho, dāni so sattho’ti bahuṃ tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca udakañca āropetvā satthaṃ payāpesi.
segments.dn23:23.39: Dvīhatīhapayāto kho pana so sattho addasa purisaṃ kāḷaṃ lohitakkhaṃ sannaddhakalāpaṃ kumudamāliṃ allavatthaṃ allakesaṃ kaddamamakkhitehi cakkehi bhadrena rathena paṭipathaṃ āgacchantaṃ, disvā etadavoca –
segments.dn23:23.45: ‘Evaṃ, bho, purato kantāre mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho. Āsittodakāni vaṭumāni, bahu tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca udakañca.
segments.dn23:23.46: Chaḍḍetha, bho, purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, lahubhārehi sakaṭehi sīghaṃ sīghaṃ gacchatha, mā yoggāni kilamitthā’ti.
segments.dn23:23.48: ‘ayaṃ, bho,“puriso evamāha – purato kantāre mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho, āsittodakāni vaṭumāni, bahu tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca udakañca.
segments.dn23:23.50: Chaḍḍetha, bho, purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, lahubhārehi sakaṭehi sīghaṃ sīghaṃ gacchatha; mā yoggāni kilamitthā”ti.
segments.dn23:23.51: Ayaṃ bho puriso neva amhākaṃ mitto, na ñātisālohito, kathaṃ mayaṃ imassa saddhāya gamissāma.
segments.dn23:23.52: Na vo chaḍḍetabbāni purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, yathābhatena bhaṇḍena satthaṃ payāpetha.
segments.dn23:23.54: ‘Evaṃ, bho’ti kho te satthikā tassa satthavāhassa paṭissutvā yathābhatena bhaṇḍena satthaṃ payāpesuṃ.
segments.dn23:23.55: Te paṭhamepi satthavāse na addasaṃsu tiṇaṃ vā kaṭṭhaṃ vā udakaṃ vā.
segments.dn23:23.56: Dutiyepi satthavāse … tatiyepi satthavāse … catutthepi satthavāse … pañcamepi satthavāse … chaṭṭhepi satthavāse … sattamepi satthavāse na addasaṃsu tiṇaṃ vā kaṭṭhaṃ vā udakaṃ vā.
segments.dn23:23.63: Ye ca tasmiṃ satthepi ahesuṃ manussā vā pasū vā, tesañca aṭṭhikāneva addasaṃsu tena yakkhena amanussena bhakkhitānaṃ.
segments.dn23:23.65: ‘ayaṃ kho, bho, sattho anayabyasanaṃ āpanno, yathā taṃ tena bālena satthavāhena pariṇāyakena.
segments.dn23:23.66: Tena hi, bho, yānamhākaṃ satthe appasārāni paṇiyāni, tāni chaḍḍetvā, yāni imasmiṃ satthe mahāsārāni paṇiyāni, tāni ādiyathā’ti.
segments.dn23:23.67: ‘Evaṃ, bho’ti kho te satthikā tassa satthavāhassa paṭissutvā yāni sakasmiṃ satthe appasārāni paṇiyāni, tāni chaḍḍetvā yāni tasmiṃ satthe mahāsārāni paṇiyāni, tāni ādiyitvā sotthinā taṃ kantāraṃ nitthariṃsu, yathā taṃ paṇḍitena satthavāhena pariṇāyakena.
segments.dn23:23.68: Evameva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, bālo abyatto anayabyasanaṃ āpajjissasi ayoniso paralokaṃ gavesanto seyyathāpi so purimo satthavāho.
segments.dn23:23.69: Yepi tava [te (ka.)] sotabbaṃ saddhātabbaṃ [saddahātabbaṃ (pī. ka.)] maññissanti, tepi anayabyasanaṃ āpajjissanti, seyyathāpi te satthikā.
segments.dn23:23.70: Paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ; paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ.
segments.dn23:23.71: Mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti.
segments.dn23:24.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho nevāhaṃ sakkomi idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjituṃ.
segments.dn23:24.2: Rājāpi maṃ pasenadi kosalo jānāti tirorājānopi – ‘pāyāsi rājañño evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī –
segments.dn23:24.4: Sacāhaṃ, bho kassapa, idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjissāmi, bhavissanti me vattāro –
segments.dn23:24.6: Kopenapi naṃ harissāmi, makkhenapi naṃ harissāmi, palāsenapi naṃ harissāmī”ti.
segments.dn23:25.2: Upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:25.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, aññataro sūkaraposako puriso sakamhā gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ agamāsi.
segments.dn23:25.6: ‘ayaṃ kho pahuto sukkhagūtho chaḍḍito, mama ca sūkarabhattaṃ [sūkarānaṃ bhakkho (syā.)];
segments.dn23:25.8: So uttarāsaṅgaṃ pattharitvā pahūtaṃ sukkhagūthaṃ ākiritvā bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhitvā sīse ubbāhetvā [uccāropetvā (ka. sī. ka.)] agamāsi.
segments.dn23:25.10: So uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ yāva agganakhā gūthena makkhito gūthabhāraṃ ādāya agamāsi.
segments.dn23:25.12: ‘kacci no tvaṃ, bhaṇe, ummatto, kacci viceto, kathañhi nāma uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ yāva agganakhā gūthena makkhito gūthabhāraṃ harissasī’ti.
segments.dn23:25.13: ‘Tumhe khvettha, bhaṇe, ummattā, tumhe vicetā, tathā hi pana me sūkarabhattan’ti.
segments.dn23:25.14: Evameva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, gūthabhārikūpamo [gūthahārikūpamo (sī. pī.)] maññe paṭibhāsi.
segments.dn23:25.15: Paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ. Paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ.
segments.dn23:25.16: Mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti.
segments.dn23:26.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho nevāhaṃ sakkomi idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjituṃ.
segments.dn23:26.2: Rājāpi maṃ pasenadi kosalo jānāti tirorājānopi –
segments.dn23:26.5: Sacāhaṃ, bho kassapa, idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjissāmi, bhavissanti me vattāro –
segments.dn23:26.7: Kopenapi naṃ harissāmi, makkhenapi naṃ harissāmi, palāsenapi naṃ harissāmī”ti.
segments.dn23:27.1: “Tena hi, rājañña, upamaṃ te karissāmi, upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:27.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, dve akkhadhuttā akkhehi dibbiṃsu.
segments.dn23:27.5: Addasā kho dutiyo akkhadhutto taṃ akkhadhuttaṃ āgatāgataṃ kaliṃ gilantaṃ, disvā taṃ akkhadhuttaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:27.6: ‘tvaṃ kho, samma, ekantikena jināsi, dehi me, samma, akkhe pajohissāmī’ti.
segments.dn23:27.7: ‘Evaṃ sammā’ti kho so akkhadhutto tassa akkhadhuttassa akkhe pādāsi.
segments.dn23:27.8: Atha kho so akkhadhutto akkhe visena paribhāvetvā taṃ akkhadhuttaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:27.10: ‘Evaṃ sammā’ti kho so akkhadhutto tassa akkhadhuttassa paccassosi.
segments.dn23:27.11: Dutiyampi kho te akkhadhuttā akkhehi dibbiṃsu.
segments.dn23:27.12: Dutiyampi kho so akkhadhutto āgatāgataṃ kaliṃ gilati.
segments.dn23:27.13: Addasā kho dutiyo akkhadhutto taṃ akkhadhuttaṃ dutiyampi āgatāgataṃ kaliṃ gilantaṃ, disvā taṃ akkhadhuttaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn23:27.14: “Littaṃ paramena tejasā, gilamakkhaṃ puriso na bujjhati;
segments.dn23:27.16: Gila re gila pāpadhuttaka [gili re pāpadhuttaka (ka.)], pacchā te kaṭukaṃ bhavissatīti.
segments.dn23:27.18: “Evameva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, akkhadhuttakūpamo maññe paṭibhāsi.
segments.dn23:27.19: Paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ; paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ.
segments.dn23:27.20: Mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti.
segments.dn23:28.1: “Kiñcāpi bhavaṃ kassapo evamāha, atha kho nevāhaṃ sakkomi idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjituṃ.
segments.dn23:28.2: Rājāpi maṃ pasenadi kosalo jānāti tirorājānopi –
segments.dn23:28.5: Sacāhaṃ, bho kassapa, idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjissāmi, bhavissanti me vattāro –
segments.dn23:28.7: Kopenapi naṃ harissāmi, makkhenapi naṃ harissāmi, palāsenapi naṃ harissāmī”ti.
segments.dn23:29.1: “Tena hi, rājañña, upamaṃ te karissāmi, upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.dn23:29.5: ‘āyāma, samma, yena so janapado tenupasaṅkamissāma, appeva nāmettha kiñci dhanaṃ adhigaccheyyāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:29.7: Te yena so janapado, yena aññataraṃ gāmapaṭṭaṃ [gāmapajjaṃ (syā.), gāmapattaṃ (sī.)] tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ sāṇaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā sahāyako sahāyakaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn23:29.8: ‘idaṃ kho, samma, pahūtaṃ sāṇaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, tena hi, samma, tvañca sāṇabhāraṃ bandha, ahañca sāṇabhāraṃ bandhissāmi, ubho sāṇabhāraṃ ādāya gamissāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:29.9: ‘Evaṃ sammā’ti kho sahāyako sahāyakassa paṭissutvā sāṇabhāraṃ bandhitvā te ubho sāṇabhāraṃ ādāya yena aññataraṃ gāmapaṭṭaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
segments.dn23:29.10: Tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ sāṇasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā sahāyako sahāyakaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn23:29.11: ‘yassa kho, samma, atthāya iccheyyāma sāṇaṃ, idaṃ pahūtaṃ sāṇasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ.
segments.dn23:29.12: Tena hi, samma, tvañca sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍehi, ahañca sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍessāmi, ubho sāṇasuttabhāraṃ ādāya gamissāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:29.13: ‘Ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūrābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me tvaṃ pajānāhī’ti.
segments.dn23:29.14: Atha kho so sahāyako sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā sāṇasuttabhāraṃ ādiyi.
segments.dn23:29.16: Tattha addasaṃsu pahūtā sāṇiyo chaḍḍitā, disvā sahāyako sahāyakaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn23:29.17: ‘yassa kho, samma, atthāya iccheyyāma sāṇaṃ vā sāṇasuttaṃ vā, imā pahūtā sāṇiyo chaḍḍitā.
segments.dn23:29.18: Tena hi, samma, tvañca sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍehi, ahañca sāṇasuttabhāraṃ chaḍḍessāmi, ubho sāṇibhāraṃ ādāya gamissāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:29.19: ‘Ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūrābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me, tvaṃ pajānāhī’ti.
segments.dn23:29.20: Atha kho so sahāyako sāṇasuttabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā sāṇibhāraṃ ādiyi.
segments.dn23:29.22: Tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ khomaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pe … pahūtaṃ khomasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ khomadussaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ kappāsaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ kappāsikasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ kappāsikadussaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ ayaṃ [ayasaṃ (syā.)] chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ lohaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ tipuṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ sīsaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ sajjhaṃ [sajjhuṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā … pahūtaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā sahāyako sahāyakaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn23:29.34: ‘yassa kho, samma, atthāya iccheyyāma sāṇaṃ vā sāṇasuttaṃ vā sāṇiyo vā khomaṃ vā khomasuttaṃ vā khomadussaṃ vā kappāsaṃ vā kappāsikasuttaṃ vā kappāsikadussaṃ vā ayaṃ vā lohaṃ vā tipuṃ vā sīsaṃ vā sajjhaṃ vā, idaṃ pahūtaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ.
segments.dn23:29.35: Tena hi, samma, tvañca sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍehi, ahañca sajjhabhāraṃ [sajjhubhāraṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] chaḍḍessāmi, ubho suvaṇṇabhāraṃ ādāya gamissāmā’ti.
segments.dn23:29.36: ‘Ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūrābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me tvaṃ pajānāhī’ti.
segments.dn23:29.37: Atha kho so sahāyako sajjhabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā suvaṇṇabhāraṃ ādiyi.
segments.dn23:29.39: Tattha yo so sahāyako sāṇabhāraṃ ādāya agamāsi, tassa neva mātāpitaro abhinandiṃsu, na puttadārā abhinandiṃsu, na mittāmaccā abhinandiṃsu, na ca tatonidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ adhigacchi.
segments.dn23:29.40: Yo pana so sahāyako suvaṇṇabhāraṃ ādāya agamāsi, tassa mātāpitaropi abhinandiṃsu, puttadārāpi abhinandiṃsu, mittāmaccāpi abhinandiṃsu, tatonidānañca sukhaṃ somanassaṃ adhigacchi.
segments.dn23:29.41: “Evameva kho tvaṃ, rājañña, sāṇabhārikūpamo maññe paṭibhāsi.
segments.dn23:29.42: Paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ; paṭinissajjetaṃ, rājañña, pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ.
segments.dn23:29.43: Mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti.
segments.dn23:30.1: “Purimeneva ahaṃ opammena bhoto kassapassa attamano abhiraddho.
segments.dn23:30.2: Api cāhaṃ imāni vicitrāni pañhāpaṭibhānāni sotukāmo evāhaṃ bhavantaṃ kassapaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ.
segments.dn23:30.3: Abhikkantaṃ, bho kassapa, abhikkantaṃ, bho kassapa.
segments.dn23:30.4: Seyyathāpi, bho kassapa, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti evamevaṃ bhotā kassapena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
segments.dn23:30.5: Esāhaṃ, bho kassapa, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca, bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.dn23:30.6: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ kassapo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
segments.dn23:30.7: “Icchāmi cāhaṃ, bho kassapa, mahāyaññaṃ yajituṃ, anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ kassapo, yaṃ mamassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
segments.dn23:31.1: “Yathārūpe kho, rājañña, yaññe gāvo vā haññanti ajeḷakā vā haññanti, kukkuṭasūkarā vā haññanti, vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti micchādiṭṭhī micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākammantā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño na mahapphalo hoti na mahānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.
segments.dn23:31.2: Seyyathāpi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya.
segments.dn23:31.3: So tattha dukkhette dubbhūme avihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhāpeyya khaṇḍāni pūtīni vātātapahatāni asāradāni asukhasayitāni.
segments.dn23:31.4: Devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
segments.dn23:31.5: Api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ [viruḷhiṃ (moggalāne)] vepullaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ, kassako vā vipulaṃ phalaṃ adhigaccheyyā”ti?
segments.dn23:31.7: “Evameva kho, rājañña, yathārūpe yaññe gāvo vā haññanti, ajeḷakā vā haññanti, kukkuṭasūkarā vā haññanti, vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti micchādiṭṭhī micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākammantā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño na mahapphalo hoti na mahānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.
segments.dn23:31.8: “Yathārūpe ca kho, rājañña, yaññe neva gāvo haññanti, na ajeḷakā haññanti, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññanti, na vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti sammādiṭṭhī sammāsaṅkappā sammāvācā sammākammantā sammāājīvā sammāvāyāmā sammāsatī sammāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
segments.dn23:31.9: Seyyathāpi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya.
segments.dn23:31.10: So tattha sukhette subhūme suvihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhapeyya akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni.
segments.dn23:31.11: Devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
segments.dn23:31.12: Api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ, kassako vā vipulaṃ phalaṃ adhigaccheyyā”ti?
segments.dn23:31.14: “Evameva kho, rājañña, yathārūpe yaññe neva gāvo haññanti, na ajeḷakā haññanti, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññanti, na vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti sammādiṭṭhī sammāsaṅkappā sammāvācā sammākammantā sammāājīvā sammāvāyāmā sammāsatī sammāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro”ti.
segments.dn23:32.1: Atha kho pāyāsi rājañño dānaṃ paṭṭhapesi samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavaṇibbakayācakānaṃ.
segments.dn23:32.2: Tasmiṃ kho pana dāne evarūpaṃ bhojanaṃ dīyati kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyaṃ, dhorakāni [thorakāni (sī. pī.), corakāni (syā.)] ca vatthāni guḷavālakāni [guḷagāḷakāni (ka.)].
segments.dn23:32.3: Tasmiṃ kho pana dāne uttaro nāma māṇavo vāvaṭo [byāvaṭo (sī. pī.)] ahosi.
segments.dn23:32.5: “imināhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññameva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin”ti.
segments.dn23:32.7: “uttaro kira māṇavo dānaṃ datvā evaṃ anuddisati –
segments.dn23:32.8: ‘imināhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññameva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin’”ti.
segments.dn23:32.9: Atha kho pāyāsi rājañño uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca –
segments.dn23:32.10: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, tāta uttara, dānaṃ datvā evaṃ anuddisasi –
segments.dn23:32.11: ‘imināhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññameva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin’”ti?
segments.dn23:32.13: “Kissa pana tvaṃ, tāta uttara, dānaṃ datvā evaṃ anuddisasi –
segments.dn23:32.14: ‘imināhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññameva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin’ti?
segments.dn23:32.15: Nanu mayaṃ, tāta uttara, puññatthikā dānasseva phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhino”ti?
segments.dn23:32.16: “Bhoto kho dāne evarūpaṃ bhojanaṃ dīyati kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyaṃ, yaṃ bhavaṃ pādāpi [pādāsi (ka.)] na iccheyya samphusituṃ [chupituṃ (pī. ka.)], kuto bhuñjituṃ, dhorakāni ca vatthāni guḷavālakāni, yāni bhavaṃ pādāpi [acittikataṃ (ka.)] na iccheyya samphusituṃ, kuto paridahituṃ.
segments.dn23:32.17: Bhavaṃ kho panamhākaṃ piyo manāpo, kathaṃ mayaṃ manāpaṃ amanāpena saṃyojemā”ti?
segments.dn23:32.18: “Tena hi tvaṃ, tāta uttara, yādisāhaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjāmi, tādisaṃ bhojanaṃ paṭṭhapehi.
segments.dn23:32.19: Yādisāni cāhaṃ vatthāni paridahāmi, tādisāni ca vatthāni paṭṭhapehī”ti.
segments.dn23:32.20: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho uttaro māṇavo pāyāsissa rājaññassa paṭissutvā yādisaṃ bhojanaṃ pāyāsi rājañño bhuñjati, tādisaṃ bhojanaṃ paṭṭhapesi.
segments.dn23:32.21: Yādisāni ca vatthāni pāyāsi rājañño paridahati, tādisāni ca vatthāni paṭṭhapesi.
segments.dn23:32.22: Atha kho pāyāsi rājañño asakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā asahatthā dānaṃ datvā acittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā apaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajji suññaṃ serīsakaṃ vimānaṃ.
segments.dn23:32.23: Yo pana tassa dāne vāvaṭo ahosi uttaro nāma māṇavo. So sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā sahatthā dānaṃ datvā cittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā anapaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajji devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ.
segments.dn23:33.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā gavampati abhikkhaṇaṃ suññaṃ serīsakaṃ vimānaṃ divāvihāraṃ gacchati.
segments.dn23:33.2: Atha kho pāyāsi devaputto yenāyasmā gavampati tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ gavampatiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho pāyāsiṃ devaputtaṃ āyasmā gavampati etadavoca –
segments.dn23:33.6: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’”ti?
segments.dn23:33.8: ‘itipi natthi paro loko, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko’ti.
segments.dn23:33.9: Api cāhaṃ ayyena kumārakassapena etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecito”ti.
segments.dn23:33.10: “Yo pana te, āvuso, dāne vāvaṭo ahosi uttaro nāma māṇavo, so kuhiṃ upapanno”ti?
segments.dn23:33.11: “Yo me, bhante, dāne vāvaṭo ahosi uttaro nāma māṇavo, so sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā sahatthā dānaṃ datvā cittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā anapaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ.
segments.dn23:33.12: Ahaṃ pana, bhante, asakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā asahatthā dānaṃ datvā acittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā apaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapanno suññaṃ serīsakaṃ vimānaṃ.
segments.dn23:33.13: Tena hi, bhante gavampati, manussalokaṃ gantvā evamārocehi –
segments.dn23:33.14: ‘sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ detha, sahatthā dānaṃ detha, cittīkataṃ dānaṃ detha, anapaviddhaṃ dānaṃ detha.
segments.dn23:33.15: Pāyāsi rājañño asakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā asahatthā dānaṃ datvā acittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā apaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapanno suññaṃ serīsakaṃ vimānaṃ.
segments.dn23:33.16: Yo pana tassa dāne vāvaṭo ahosi uttaro nāma māṇavo, so sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā sahatthā dānaṃ datvā cittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā anapaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyatan’”ti.
segments.dn23:34.1: Atha kho āyasmā gavampati manussalokaṃ āgantvā evamārocesi –
segments.dn23:34.2: “sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ detha, sahatthā dānaṃ detha, cittīkataṃ dānaṃ detha, anapaviddhaṃ dānaṃ detha.
segments.dn23:34.3: Pāyāsi rājañño asakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā asahatthā dānaṃ datvā acittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā apaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapanno suññaṃ serīsakaṃ vimānaṃ.
segments.dn23:34.4: Yo pana tassa dāne vāvaṭo ahosi uttaro nāma māṇavo, so sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā sahatthā dānaṃ datvā cittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā anapaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyatan”ti.
segments.dn23:35.5: Mahāsatipaṭṭhānañca, pāyāsi dasamaṃ bhave [satipaṭṭhānapāyāsi, mahāvaggassa saṅgaho (sī. pī.) satipaṭṭhānapāyāsi, mahāvaggoti vuccatīti (syā.)].

lines: Kumārakāle pabbajitattā pana bhagavatā “kassapaṃ pakkosatha, idaṃ phalaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā kassapassa dethā”ti vutte “katarakassapassā”ti.
“Kumārakassapassā”ti evaṃ gahitanāmattā tato paṭṭhāya vuḍḍhakālepi “kumārakassapo” tveva vuccati.
Apica rañño posāvanikaputtattāpi taṃ kumārakassapoti sañjāniṃsu.
Ayaṃ panassa pubbayogato paṭṭhāya āvibhāvakathā – thero kira padumuttarassa bhagavato kāle seṭṭhiputto ahosi.

Athekadivasaṃ bhagavantaṃ citrakathiṃ ekaṃ attano sāvakaṃ etadagge ṭhapentaṃ disvā bhagavato sattāhaṃ dānaṃ datvā “ahampi bhagavā anāgate ekassa buddhassa ayaṃ thero viya citrakathī sāvako bhavāmī”ti patthanaṃ katvā puññāni karonto kassapassa bhagavato sāsane pabbajitvā visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ nāsakkhi.
Tadā kira parinibbutassa bhagavato sāsane osakkante pañca bhikkhū nisseṇiṃ bandhitvā pabbataṃ āruyha samaṇadhammaṃ akaṃsu.
Saṅghatthero tatiyadivase arahattaṃ patto, anuthero catutthadivase anāgāmī ahosi, itare tayo visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ asakkontā devaloke nibbattā.

Tesaṃ ekaṃ buddhantaraṃ devesu ca manussesu ca sampattiṃ anubhavantānaṃ eko takkasilāyaṃ rājakule nibbattitvā pakkusāti nāma rājā hutvā bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajitvā rājagahaṃ uddissa āgacchanto kumbhakārasālāyaṃ bhagavato dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anāgāmiphalaṃ patto.

Eko ekasmiṃ samuddapaṭṭane kulaghare nibbattitvā nāvaṃ āruyha bhinnanāvo dārucīrāni nivāsetvā lābhasampattiṃ patto “ahaṃ arahā”ti cittaṃ uppādetvā “na tvaṃ arahā, gaccha, satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchā”ti atthakāmāya devatāya codito tathā katvā arahattaphalaṃ patto.
Eko rājagahe ekissā kuladārikāya kucchimhi uppanno.
Sā ca paṭhamaṃ mātāpitaro yācitvā pabbajjaṃ alabhamānā kulagharaṃ gantvā gabbhaṃ gaṇhi.
Gabbhasaṇṭhitampi ajānanti sāmikaṃ ārādhetvā tena anuññātā bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā, tassā gabbhanimittaṃ disvā bhikkhuniyo devadattaṃ pucchiṃsu.
Thero sāvatthinagaravāsīni kulāni visākhañca upāsikaṃ pakkosāpetvā sodhento “pure laddho gabbho, pabbajjā arogā”ti āha.
Taṃ gahetvā rājā pasenadi kosalo posāpesi.
“Kassapo”ti cassa nāmaṃ katvā aparabhāge alaṅkaritvā satthu santikaṃ netvā pabbājesi.
Taṃ ekadivasaṃ andhavane samaṇadhammaṃ karontaṃ atthakāmā devatā pañhe uggahāpetvā “ime pañhe bhagavantaṃ pucchā”ti āha.
Thero pañhe pucchitvā pañhavissajjanāvasāne arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
Bhagavāpi taṃ citrakathikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapesi.
Yathā gūthagataṃ muttagatanti vutte na gūthādito aññaṃ atthi, evaṃ diṭṭhiyeva diṭṭhigataṃ.
Itipi natthīti taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ apadisitvā evampi natthīti vadati.

Ime bho, kassapa, candimasūriyāti so kira therena pucchito cintesi “ayaṃ samaṇo paṭhamaṃ candimasūriye upamaṃ āhari, candimasūriyasadiso bhavissati paññāya, anabhibhavanīyo aññena, sace panāhaṃ ‘candimasūriyā imasmiṃ loke’ti bhaṇissāmi,‘kiṃ nissitā ete, kittakapamāṇā, kittakaṃ uccā’tiādīhi paliveṭhessati.
Ahaṃ kho panetaṃ nibbeṭhetuṃ na sakkhissāmi,‘parasmiṃ loke’ iccevassa kathessāmī”ti.
Bhagavā pana tato pubbe na cirasseva sudhābhojanīyajātakaṃ kathesi.
Tattha “cande cando devaputto, sūriye sūriyo devaputto”ti āgataṃ.
Bhagavatā ca kathitaṃ jātakaṃ vā suttantaṃ vā sakalajambudīpe patthaṭaṃ hoti, tena so “ettha nivāsino devaputtā natthī”ti na sakkā vattunti cintetvā devā te na manussāti āha.
Atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyoti atthi pana kāraṇanti pucchati.
Saddhāyikāti ahaṃ tumhe saddahāmi, tumhe mayhaṃ saddhāyikā saddhāyitabbavacanāti attho.
Paccayikāti ahaṃ tumhe pattiyāmi, tumhe mayhaṃ paccayikā pattiyāyitabbāti attho.
Uddisitvāti tesaṃ attānañca paṭisāmitabhaṇḍakañca dassetvā, sampaṭicchāpetvāti attho.
Vippalapantassāti “putto me, dhītā me, dhanaṃ me”ti vividhaṃ palapantassa.
Ye pana “kammameva kammakāraṇaṃ karoti, natthi nirayapālā”ti vadanti.
Manussaloke rājakulesu kāraṇikamanussā viya hi niraye nirayapālā honti.
Sunimmajjathāti yathā suṭṭhu nimmajjitaṃ hoti, evaṃ nimmajjatha, apanethāti attho.
Ubbādhatīti divasassa dvikkhattuṃ nhatvā tikkhattuṃ vatthāni parivattetvā alaṅkatapaṭimaṇḍitānaṃ cakkavattiādīnampi manussānaṃ gandho yojanasate ṭhitānaṃ devatānaṃ kaṇṭhe āsattakuṇapaṃ viya bādhati.
Tāvatiṃsānanti idañca dūre nibbattā tāva mā āgacchantu, ime kasmā na entīti vadati.
Upavijaññāti upagatavijāyanakālā, paripakkagabbhā na cirasseva vijāyissatīti attho.
Ayoti sukhaṃ, na ayo anayo, dukkhaṃ.
Tadetaṃ sabbaso sukhaṃ byasati vikkhipatīti byasanaṃ.
Apakkaṃ na paripācentīti apariṇataṃ akhīṇaṃ āyuṃ antarāva na upacchindanti.
Tuyhaṃ jīvanti supinadassanakāle nikkhamantaṃ vā pavisantaṃ vā jīvaṃ api nu passanti.
Tumhe jīvakāle sattassa pañcakkhandhāti vadanti, cavanakāle pana rūpakkhandhamattameva avasissati, tayo khandhā appavattā honti, viññāṇakkhandho gacchati.
Avasiṭṭhena rūpakkhandhena lahutarena bhavitabbaṃ, garukataro ca hoti.
Tasmā natthi koci kuhiṃ gantāti imamatthaṃ dasseti.
Tañcāyatanaṃ na paṭisaṃvedetīti tena cakkhunā taṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na vibhāveti.
Kopenapīti ye maṃ evaṃ vakkhanti, tesu uppajjanakena kopenapi etaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ harissāmi pariharissāmīti gahetvā vicarissāmi.
Haritakapaṇṇanti yaṃ kiñci haritakaṃ, antamaso allatiṇapaṇṇampi na hotīti attho.
Āsittodakāni vaṭumānīti paripuṇṇasalilā maggā ca kandarā ca.
Yathābhatena bhaṇḍenāti yaṃ vo tiṇakaṭṭhodakabhaṇḍakaṃ āropitaṃ, tena yathābhatena yathāropitena, yathāgahitenāti attho.
Mama ca sūkarabhattanti mama ca sūkarānaṃ idaṃ bhattaṃ.
Tumhe khvettha bhaṇeti tumhe kho ettha bhaṇe.
Tathā hi pana me sūkarabhattanti tathā hi pana me ayaṃ gūtho sūkarānaṃ bhattaṃ.
Paccanīkaṃ kattabbanti paccanīkaṃ paṭiviruddhaṃ viya kattabbaṃ amaññissaṃ, paṭilomagāhaṃ gahetvā aṭṭhāsinti attho.
Vātātapahatānīti vātena ca ātapena ca hatāni pariyādinnatejāni.
Asukhasayitānīti yāni sukkhāpetvā koṭṭhe ākiritvā ṭhapitāni, tāni sukhasayitāni nāma.
Anuppaveccheyyāti anupaveseyya, na sammā vasseyya, anvaddhamāsaṃ anudasāhaṃ anupañcāhaṃ na vasseyyāti attho.
Api nu tānīti api nu evaṃ khettabījavuṭṭhidose sati tāni bījāni aṅkuramūlapattādīhi uddhaṃ vuddhiṃ heṭṭhā virūḷhiṃ samantato ca vepullaṃ āpajjeyyunti.
Evarūpo kho rājañña yaññoti evarūpaṃ rājañña dānaṃ parūpaghātena uppāditapaccayatopi dāyakatopi pariggāhakatopi avisuddhattā na mahapphalaṃ hoti.
Evarūpo kho rājañña yaññoti evarūpaṃ rājaññadānaṃ aparūpaghātena uppannapaccayatopi aparūpaghātitāya sīlavantadāyakatopi sammādiṭṭhiādiguṇasampannapaṭiggāhakatopi mahapphalaṃ hoti.
Sace pana guṇātirekaṃ nirodhā vuṭṭhitaṃ paṭiggāhakaṃ labhati, cetanā ca vipulā hoti, diṭṭheva dhamme vipākaṃ detīti.
Imaṃ pana therassa dhammakathaṃ sutvā pāyāsirājañño theraṃ nimantetvā sattāhaṃ therassa mahādānaṃ datvā tato paṭṭhāya mahājanassa dānaṃ paṭṭhapesi.
Taṃ sandhāya atha kho pāyāsi rājaññotiādi vuttaṃ.
Acittīkatanti cittīkāravirahitaṃ, na cittīkārampi paccupaṭṭhāpetvā na paṇītacittaṃ katvā adāsi.
Suññaṃ serīsakanti serīsakaṃ nāma ekaṃ tucchaṃ rajatavimānaṃ upagato.
Tassa kira dvāre mahāsirīsarukkho, tena taṃ “serīsakan”ti vuccati.

Āyasmā gavaṃpatīti thero kira pubbe manussakāle gopāladārakānaṃ jeṭṭhako hutvā mahato sirīsassa mūlaṃ sodhetvā vālikaṃ okiritvā ekaṃ piṇḍapātikattheraṃ rukkhamūle nisīdāpetvā attanā laddhaṃ āhāraṃ datvā tato cuto tassānubhāvena tasmiṃ rajatavimāne nibbatti.
So paññāsāya vassehi phalati, tato paññāsa vassāni gatānīti devaputto saṃvegaṃ āpajjati.
So aparena samayena amhākaṃ bhagavato kāle manussesu nibbattitvā satthu dhammakathaṃ sutvā arahattaṃ patto.
Pubbāciṇṇavasena pana divāvihāratthāya tadeva vimānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ gacchati, taṃ kirassa utusukhaṃ hoti.
Taṃ sandhāya “tena kho pana samayena āyasmā gavaṃpatī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
So sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvāti so parassa santakampi dānaṃ sakkaccaṃ datvā.
Tañca pana therassa ārocanaṃ sutvā mahājano sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā devaloke nibbatto.
Pāyāsissa pana rājaññassa paricārakā sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvāpi nikantivasena gantvā tasseva santike nibbattā.
Pāyāsidevaputto ca ekadivasaṃ vāṇijakānaṃ dassetvā attano katakammaṃ kathesīti.
Puññāni karonto kappasatasahassaṃ devesu ceva manussesu ca uppajjitvā visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ nāsakkhi indriyānaṃ aparipakkattā.
Tesaṃ sāvakabodhiyā niyatatāya, puññasambhārassa ca sātisayattā vinipātaṃ agantvā ekaṃ buddhantaraṃ … pe … anubhavantānaṃ.
“Kuladārikāya kucchimhi uppanno”ti vatvā taṃ evassa uppannabhāvaṃ mūlato paṭṭhāya dassetuṃ “sā cā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Satipi visākhāya ca sāvatthivāsikulapariyāpannatte tassā tattha padhānabhāvadassanatthaṃ “visākhañcā”ti vuttaṃ yathā “brāhmaṇā āgatā vāsiṭṭhopi āgato”ti.
Pañheti “bhikkhu bhikkhu ayaṃ vammiko”tiādinā (ma. ni.1.249) āgate pannarasapañhe.
Atthavacanena pana uttarasaddaṃ apekkhitvā setabyatoti nissakkappayogo kato.

Diṭṭhiyeva diṭṭhigatanti gata-saddena padavaḍḍhanamāha, diṭṭhiyā vā gatamattaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ, ayāthāvaggāhitāya gantabbābhāvato diṭṭhiyā gahaṇamattaṃ, kevalo micchābhinivesoti attho, taṃ pana diṭṭhigataṃ tassa ayonisomanasikārādivasena uppajjitvā paṭipakkhasammukhībhāvābhāvato, anurūpāhāralābhato ca samudācārappattaṃ jātanti pāḷiyaṃ “uppannaṃ hotī”ti vuttaṃ.
Taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ apadisitvāti tato idhāgacchanakassa, ito tattha gacchanakassa ca apadisanato “tattha tattheva sattānaṃ ucchijjanato”ti evamādi taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ paṭirūpakaṃ apadisitvā.
Āpannānadhippetatthavisaye ayaṃ purā -saddapayogoti āha “purā … pe … saññāpetīti yāva na saññāpetī”ti.
Yathā candimasūriyā uḷāravipulobhāsatāya aññena obhāsena anabhibhavanīyā, evamayampi paññāobhāsenāti dassento “candima … pe … aññenā”tiādimāha.
Ādīhīti ādi -saddena “kittake ṭhāne ete pavattenti, kittakañca ṭhānaṃ nesaṃ ābhā pharatī”ti evamādimpi codanaṃ saṅgaṇhāti.
Tasmāti yasmā yathāvuttaṃ codanaṃ nibbeṭhetuṃ na sakkoti, tasmā.
Attano anicchitaṃ saṅghātanaṃ pakkhaṃ paṭijānanto “parasmiṃ loke, na imasmin”tiādimāha.
Kathaṃ panāyaṃ natthikadiṭṭhi “devo”ti paṭijānātīti tattha kāraṇaṃ dassetuṃ “bhagavā panā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
“Devāpi devattabhāveneva ucchijjanti, manussāpi manussattabhāveneva ucchijjantī”ti evaṃ vā assa diṭṭhi, evañca katvā “devā te, na manussā”ti vacanañca na virujjhati.
Evaṃ candeti candavimāne, na ca cande vā kathiyante.
Kammakāraṇaṃ karotīti āyūhanānurūpaṃ taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ karoti, tathā dukkhaṃ uppādetīti attho.
Nirayapālāti ettha iti -saddo ādiattho, tena tattha sabbaṃ nirayakaṇḍapāḷiṃ (ma. ni.3.259) saṅgaṇhāti.
Evaṃ suttato (ma. ni.3.259) nirayapālānaṃ atthibhāvaṃ dassetvā idāni yuttitopi dassetuṃ “manussaloke”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tattha nerayike niraye pālenti tato niggantuṃ appadānavasena rakkhantīti nirayapālā.
Taṃ pana tassa tassa gūthassa tathā sodhanaṃ apanayanaṃ hotīti āha “apanethā”ti.
Asucīti asuddho, so pana yasmā manavaḍḍhanako manoharo na hoti, tasmā āha “amanāpo”ti.
Asucisaṅkhātaṃ asucibhāgataṃ attano sabhāvataṃ gato pattoti asucisaṅkhātoti āha “asucikoṭṭhāsabhūto”ti.
Duggandhoti duṭṭhagandho aniṭṭhagandho, so pana na yo koci, atha kho pūtigandhoti āha “kuṇapagandho”ti.
Manussānaṃ gandho … pe … bādhati ativiya asucisabhāvattā, asucimhiyeva jātasaṃvaddhanabhāvato, devānañca ghānapasādassa tikkhavisadabhāvato.
Nibbisanti yassa pana taṃ kammaphalaṃ nibbisanto niyuñjanto, nibbisanti vā nibbesaṃ vetanaṃ paṭikaṅkhanto bhatapuriso yathā.
“Nikkhamantaṃ vā pavisantaṃ vā jīvan”ti idaṃ tassa ajjhāsayavasena vuttaṃ.

So hi “sattānaṃ supinadassanakāle attabhāvato jīvo bahi nikkhamitvā taṃtaṃārāmarāmaṇeyyakadassanādivasena ito cito ca paribbhamitvā punadeva attabhāvaṃ anupavisatī”ti evaṃ pavattamicchāgāhavipallattacitto.
Athassa thero khuddakāya āṇiyā vipulaṃ āṇiṃ nīharanto viya jīvasamaññāmukhena ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ nīharitukāmo “api nu tā tuyhaṃ jīvaṃ passanti pavisantaṃ vā nikkhamantaṃ vā”ti āha.
Yattha pana tathārūpā jīvasamaññā, taṃ dassento “cittācāraṃ jīvanti gahetvā āhā”ti vuttaṃ.
Utusamuṭṭhānarūpadhammasamūhamattameva hi tadā labbhati, matta-saddo vā visesanivattiattho, tena kammajāditisantatirūpavisesaṃ nivatteti.
Appavattā hontīti appavattikā honti, na upalabbhatīti attho.
Viññāṇe pana jīvasaññī, tasmā “viññāṇakkhandho gacchatī”ti āha, tattha anupalabbhanatoti adhippāyo.
Āmatoti ettha ā -saddo āmisa-saddo viya upaḍḍhapariyāyoti āha “addhamato”ti, āmatoti vā īsaṃ darathena usmanā yuttamaraṇo marantoti attho.
Mīyamāno hi avigatusmo hoti, na mato viya vigatusmo.
Tathā rūpassa odhunanaṃ nāmassa orato parivattanamevāti āha “orato karothā”ti.
Orato kātukāmassa pana saṃparivattanaṃ sandhunanaṃ, taṃ pana parato karaṇanti āha “parato karothā”ti.
Paramukhaṃ katassa ito cito parivattanaṃ niddhunananti āha “aparāparaṃ karothā”ti.
Indriyāni aparibhinnānīti adhippāyena “tañcāyatanaṃ na paṭisaṃvedetī”ti vuttaṃ.
Upalāpetvāti uparūpari saddayogavasena sallāpetvā, saddayuttaṃ katvāti attho.

Āhito aggi etassa atthīti aggiko, svāssa aggikabhāvo yasmā aggihutamālāvedisampādanehi ceva indhanadhūmabarihisasappitelūpaharaṇehi balipupphadhūmagandhādiupahārehi ca tassa payirupāsanāya icchito, tasmā vuttaṃ “aggiparicārako”ti.
Āyuṃ pāpuṇāpeyyanti yathā cirajīvī hoti, evaṃ āyuṃ pacchimavayaṃ pāpeyyaṃ.
Vaḍḍhiṃ gameyyanti sarīrāvayave, guṇāvayave ca phātiṃ pāpeyyaṃ.
Palāsenāti palāsetīti palāso, parassa guṇe uttaritare ḍaṃsitvā viya chaḍḍento attano guṇehi same karotīti attho.
Sannaddhadhanukalāpanti ettha kalāpanti tūṇīramāha, tañca sannayhato dhanunā vinā na sannayhatīti āha “sannaddhadhanukalāpan”ti.
Āsittodakāni vaṭumānīti gamanamaggā ceva taṃtaṃudakamaggā ca sammadeva devena phuṭṭhattā tahaṃ tahaṃ paggharitaudaka sandamānaudakā.
Yathābhatenāti sakaṭesu yathāṭhapitena, yathā “amma ito karohī”ti vutte ṭhapesīti attho karaṇakiriyāya kiriyāsāmaññavācībhāvato.
Parājayaguḷanti yena guḷena, yāya salākāya ṭhitāya ca parājayo hoti, taṃ adassanaṃ gamento gilati.
Gāmapattanti gāmo eva hutvā āpajjitabbaṃ, suññabhāvena anāvasitabbaṃ.
Gāmapadanti yathā purisassa pādanikkhittaṭṭhānaṃ adhigataparicchedaṃ “padan”ti vuccati, evaṃ gāmavāsīhi āvasitaṭṭhānaṃ adhigatanivutthāgāraṃ “gāmapadan”ti vuttaṃ.
Taṃ pana susajjanaṃ suṭṭhu bandhanavasenevāti āha “subaddho”ti.
Ayādīnampi lohabhāve satipi loha-saddo sāsane tambalohe niruḷhoti āha “lohanti tambalohan”ti.
Pañhupaṭṭhānānīti pañhesu upaṭṭhānāni mayā pucchitatthesu tumhākaṃ vissajjanavasena ñāṇupaṭṭhānāni.
Duṭṭhukhetteti usabhādidosehi dūsitakhette, taṃ pana vappābhāvato asāraṃ hotīti āha “nissārakhette”ti.
Dubbhūmeti kucchitabhūmibhāge, svāssa kucchitabhāvo asāratāya vā siyā ninnatādidosavasena vā.
Tattha paṭhamo pakkho paṭhamapadena dassitoti itaraṃ dassento “visamabhūmibhāge”ti āha.
Tāni pana yasmā sāravantāni na honti, tasmā vuttaṃ “nissārānī”ti.
Yaṃ yathājātavīhiādigatena taṇḍulena aṅkuruppādanayogyabījasāmatthiyaṃ, taṃ taṇḍulasāro, tassa ādānaṃ gahaṇaṃ tathāuppajjanameva.
Dhārāya khette anuppavesanaṃ nāma vassanameva, taṃ paṭikkhepavasena dassento āha “na sammā vasseyyā”ti.
Aṅkuramūlapattādīhīti cettha aṅkurakandādīhi uddhaṃ vuddhiṃ, mūlajaṭādīhi heṭṭhā viruḷhiṃ, pattapupphādīhi samantato ca vepullanti yojanā.
Gavādighātenapi hi tattha paṭiggāhakānaṃ ghāso saṅkīyati.
Atha kho tehi sakuṇḍakehi taṇḍulehi siddhaṃbhattaṃ uttaṇḍulameva hotīti āha “uttaṇḍulabhattan”ti.
Bilaṅgaṃ vuccati āranālaṃ bilaṅgato nibbattanato, tadeva kañjiyato jātanti kañjiyaṃ, taṃ dutiyaṃ etassāti bilaṅgadutiyaṃ, taṃ “kañjikadutiyan”ti ca vuttaṃ.
Yasmā thūlatarānipi “thūlānī”ti vattabbataṃ arahanti, tasmā “thūlāni cā”ti vuttaṃ.
Guḷadasānīti suttānaṃ thūlatāya, kañjikassa bahalatāya ca piṇḍitadasāni.
Asakkaccanti na sakkaccaṃ anādarakāraṃ, taṃ pana kammaphalasaddhāya abhāvena hotīti āha “saddhāvirahitan”ti.
Cittīkārarahitaṃ vā acittīkataṃ, yathā kataṃ paresaṃ vimhayāvahaṃ hoti, tathā akataṃ.
Apaviddhanti chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ viya apaviddhaṃ katvā, etena tasmiṃ dāne gāravākaraṇaṃ vadati.
Na kevalaṃ pubbāciṇṇavaseneva, atha kho utusukhumavasena pīti dassento “tattha kirassa utusukhaṃ hotī”ti āha.
Yadi asakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā pāyāsi tattha nibbatto, pāyāsissa paricārikā sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā kathaṃ tattha nibbattāti āha “pāyāsissa panā”ti.
Nikantivasenāti pāyāsimhi sāpekkhāvasena, pubbepi vā tattha nivutthapubbatāya.
Disācārikavimānanti ākāsaṭṭhaṃ hutvā disāsu vicaraṇakavimānaṃ, na rukkhapabbatasikharādisambandhaṃ.
Appatarepi kāle sāsanassa niyyānikabhāvaṃ dassentoti yojanā.
Ayañca rañño kittimaputto, tasmā āha “rañño … pe … sañjāniṃsū”ti.
